annotations.rationale: The IT lead's belief that policy is untouched (ev01) is contradicted by the security lead's own edit (ev05), which the engineer had already found in the audit log (ev04). The customer's later claim of an empty log (ev06) contradicts the engineer's finding (ev04); ev07 explains it plausibly as a time-zone difference but nothing in the record proves it. The exclusion fixes the labs (ev08) and is then overwritten (ev09), so the state changes twice. The engineer stays calm through the disagreements and checks the logs again before asking for the exclusion to be restored (ev10).
